root_cause.description: The shared executor accepts an arbitrary program; entry-path controls need separate judgment.

fix.description: Restrict executable selection at the shared executor boundary.

decisions.rationale: Checked returns unless allowed succeeds; allowed only accepts date. This rejects the unchecked-dispatch hypothesis, not every issue in the component.

counterevidence.claim: Checked returns before execution unless allowed succeeds.
The allowlist accepts only the constant executable date.

unresolved.claim: Other entry paths to the shared executor are outside this rejection.
